target.title: fix(ai): preserve thinking blocks on historical turns with tool calls
target.body:
## Evidence
- Added unit test `preserves thinking blocks in history assistant turns containing tool calls even when replayThinkingEnabled is false` in `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts` (passed all 51 tests).

### Real Behavior Proof
```
 ✓ |unit| packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts (51 tests) 100ms
```
When `replayThinkingEnabled` is false (e.g. reasoning: 'off'), previously all historical assistant turns had their thinking blocks stripped. If those assistant turns also contained tool calls, they were sent to Anthropic with only `tool_use` blocks and no `thinking` block, causing API validation failure.
With this fix, we preserve thinking blocks for historical turns that contain one or more tool calls, keeping Anthropic API requests valid.
